title: Texas parents honor daughter’s rescuers through a foundation that has awarded 67 scholarships
summary_full: Tragedy struck when 18-year-old student Kenli Riney died in a highway accident in Texas, with the Argote family making valiant attempts to save her. To commemorate her spirit, they founded the Kenli Foundation, which offers scholarships to young individuals showing courage and kindness. Additionally, they introduced the Argote Award Scholarship to recognize and reward the remarkable bravery of those who come to the aid of others.
